title: Meadow Mail Club ✿ February
description:
By subscribing, you will receive a 5"x7" print of a meadow-themed painting by our very own Selina, a sticker and a letter! 

If you stay in the club for a full year we'll send you the 2027 calendar of all the pieces for free in December!

The deadline to join refreshes on the 20th of each month (meaning you have from the 21st of January to the 20th of February to sign up for February's set, etc), with letters beginning to ship on the 27th to allow time for production!

title: Cold Case | Tee [FINAL SALE]
description:
Who has the final piece of evidence to put this case to rest? 🔍

A note about sizing

These tees are much smaller than intended. A miscommunication at our factory resulted in shirts two sizes smaller than intended. The larger sizes have sold out due to lots of up-sizing.

Size recommendations (refer to the size chart)

For a fitted look, buy a size 2-3" greater than your chest circumference.

For the intended, boxy cut, buy a size 4-5" greater than your chest circumference.
